name: JustCo Holdings Limited
summary: JustCo Holdings Limited manages and provides a comprehensive flexible workspace platform, with operations spanning Singapore and various international locations. The firm delivers a diverse range of office solutions, from private offices and adaptable co-working memberships – including hot desking and dedicated desks – to fully equipped meeting and event facilities, and virtual office services. Additionally, it develops a proprietary mobile application to streamline the booking process for its co-working spaces. All these services are offered under the unified brand of JustCo. The company was established in Singapore in 2011 and continues to operate from its base in the city-state.
